items.title: Real Hermitian trace-exponential envelope

source.scope: P is finite nonempty real-Hermitian deterministic canonical background. This source item does not attribute the standalone envelope, a full complex theorem or the Gaussian bridge verbatim to Tropp.

items.statement: The cited primary background describes finite self-adjoint spectra, ordinary trace and matrix functional calculus, and cautions that matrix MGFs need not exist for every parameter. It does not print the standalone bridge below. The author-derived canonical statement is: for every finite nonempty real Hermitian A and every real s, 0<tr exp(sA)≤card(I) exp(|s| ||A||op). Its private literal Gaussian application derives all-real scalar trace-exponential integrability, pointwise positivity and the exact r² envelope, with finite strictly positive ordinary expectation; it is not the full complex Tropp theorem or the source Bernstein conclusion.
assumptions: Let \(\mathcal I\) be finite and nonempty, let \(A\in\operatorname{Mat}_{\mathcal I}(\mathbb R)\) be Hermitian, and let \(s\in\mathbb R\). Real Hermitian means transpose equals itself. No sign restriction on \(s\), norm-cap premise or probability structure is needed for P.

\(\operatorname{tr}\) is the ordinary unnormalized diagonal sum; \(e^A\) is the matrix-algebra power-series exponential, not entrywise scalar exponentiation. The norm is the induced Euclidean/L2 operator norm. Nonempty dimension is essential for a strictly positive trace.

obligations.label: Author-derived deterministic real-Hermitian all-real trace envelope, with source attribution and scalar-domain boundary explicit.

bindings.boundary: Only the canonical deterministic all-real real-Hermitian ordinary trace-exponential envelope and its private material application to the four literal signed Gaussian centered sums are covered. The consumer emits scalar E tr exp(sS), with pointwise positivity/cap, scalar integrability and a finite strictly positive ordinary integral. It emits no full matrix-valued or entrywise MGF theorem, sharp variance bound, Lieb/Jensen/Golden-Thompson, independent-sum/master-tail/Bernstein/norm-tail, Ex121/p15.2/C6/complete Lemma4.4/main lower-bound result or oracle/TV/precision/query-cap/expected-cost adapter. P is derived canonical background, not a standalone full complex theorem printed by Tropp. The Ex121→p15.2 source link is the same concentration application repeated for a weighted sequence, not a logical transport from ordinary to weighted tails. Local exact-byte builds exist; independent native/source-blind/fresh-source review, reader acceptance, normal PL/V, shared graph/main/site integration and purification remain pending. No extra public T node is credited.
